meta.notes: M1 and M2 are mobile manipulators and can carry items, so they are best suited for tasks involving picking up items. G1 can carry heavier payloads and has a longer endurance, making it ideal for tasks that require more time or weight. D1 is best for aerial tasks. A1 is stationary and can only work in its location. The tasks are prioritized based on their deadlines and the capabilities of the robots.
